item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello technologicLobotomy! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

It's awesome to see you want to contribute to the site - I really can't wait to see what you'll come up with. If you're going to try your hands at writing for the site seriously though, you'll want to click that little red collapsible at the bottom of this comment - there, you'll find a plethora of useful resources created for the purpose of guiding new members of the site towards guides and other resources which will definitely help you improve your writing and seek help on it.

Without further ado though, let's actually click it, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.content:encoded:
Hello and Happy new year to all!

I've been listening to SCP podcasts a lot recently, and I thought I could use some idea swimming around in my brainspace to create something in the same style. I've listened to loads of SCP files and love the variety and creativity on display so I wanted to use some of my ideas. I'm really looking forward to exploring the site and seeing what crazy things people have come up with!

item.title: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Writers: Re: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi!

Actually a recent fan of the SCP universe (I've known it for years, but only recently got into it deep due to all these animated youtube videos explaining SCPs). Plus I decided that I should try to write one instead of moping that my ideas are too shit to be good for SCPs.

Other than SCP, I'm something of a history buff (especially Roman history), and I like comic books and manga.

So yeah, happy to be here and good year everyone!

For some weird reason, I have a lingering feeling I once did an intro on this site, but everything seems to indicate that it's my first time here. But I have this conviction that I've done an intro before! Should I call the SCP Foundation for that?

item.title: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Explorers: Re: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hi fellow explorers! I'm a student fascinated by maths and science, chemistry in particular. I found myself interested in the concept of SCPs and the creativity that comes with it. I already read a few, there are so many of them! While watching some videos and reading posts, I came up with a concept SCP, but I would like to familiarize myself more with the SCP foundation before writing one.

The question this month is definitely random haha. When I eat with friends I like to explore new places where we've never eaten before. One time a friend invited me to try a "poke bowl" and since then it has become one of my favorite foods. I recommend it to everyone, it's great to eat together with friends!

Hope to see you around!

item.title: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, readers and reviewers of the Foundation Universe!

This month's random question is: what do you think is the best kind of food to eat with friends?

Let's start off with some things to take a look at to enhance your reading, now that you're a site member:

  • If you have any questions about the Foundation'verse and its various individuals and groups of interest, head over to the Foundation Universe forum to talk about the various aspects of living/working/being in constant fear of a world where anomalies are real.
  • Did you know our site has a night mode version? If you're interested in that (and a few other neat things!), check out our Usertools page.
  • Want to leave a comment or read others' thoughts on something you've read recently? Scroll down to the bottom of that page you read, click the "Discuss" link, and take a look at the comments others have posted!

For those looking to put your knowledge of the SCP-verse to work and contribute to the site by helping develop works-in-progress, head on over to the Writing Help forums!

  • So you want to be a concept reviewer?
  • So you want to be a draft reviewer?
  • And of course, remember the Criticism Policy!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Go ahead and respond to other new members if you find that your interests overlap, and definitely ask for reading suggestions if there's a particular kind of SCP article or tale you enjoy reading. If you're looking to get started as a critiquer, feel free to mention the kind of material you particularly want to see more of on the wiki! You might even see some of our authors drop by here from time to time, if you mention you liked their work! :)

Welcome to the site!

item.title: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Explorers: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, new site members/artists/gamers/social media watchers/roleplayers/etc.!

This month's random question is: what do you think is the best kind of food to eat with friends?

Here's some places to talk to get you all started off, now that you've arrived:

  • Games and Hobbies forum: Just started playing a new game or are wondering if any other SCP site members play your favorite game? Alternatively, wondering if anyone else paints minifigures or goes to conventions? Jump into the conversations here.
  • Media Discussion forum: Have a cool video or news article that just screams of the paranormal? Talk about it and other such things here!
  • Fan Work forum: Have a cool drawing or want to see the work of some of the other artists here? Have an SCP-based mod or board game in the works? This is the place to discuss!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Have fun mingling with the other new arrivals and talking about your interests, hobbies, and plans for taking over the universe. You might also see some of our veteran users here from time to time, since you never know when someone might be looking for an artist or a voice actor or an idea-haver for the next big collaboration article or SCP project! Talk and be merry. :)

Welcome to the site!
